what: The channel is not 1 to 63 characters of `[a-z0-9_]` (a Postgres identifier).
fix: Use a short lower-case name such as `orders_changed`.

what: The payload is 8000 bytes or more in UTF-8 (NOTIFY refuses it; the limit is 7999).
fix: Send an id and let the subscriber read the rest from the database.

what: The pubsub was closed; it cannot publish or subscribe any more.
fix: Make a new pubsub, or close it only when the app shuts down.
Fix the option named in the message.
